en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European riverside town. In the foreground is a wide river with a stone embankment and riverside path. Behind it stand detached villas and multi‑storey townhouses with steep, gabled roofs and ornate façades, typical of late‑19th‑century Central European architecture. Terraced slopes planted with vines rise up the hillside, dotted with more houses and a large institutional‑looking building with corner towers. In the distance, rolling hills and an elevated church with a tall spire dominate the skyline. The overall scene shows an affluent residential district with vineyards along a river. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the image.
